scheme_name: PRISM (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups and MSMEs)
other_conditions: Any Indian citizen, including students, may apply.
When a group of students applies, a lead applicant must be identified.
Financial support is given to a single applicant; other team members receive a letter of appreciation after project completion.
The scheme primarily encourages student innovators but is open to any Indian citizen with an innovative idea.
benefits_summary: Funding up to ₹2,00,000 or 90% of the approved project cost (whichever is lower) for prototype development, with total project cost up to ₹5,00,000.
